name: Slice & Dice lowers Twin Slice's Energy cost by 5 (#743)
contract: Slice & Dice 704361 effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (misc=14, SPELLMOD_COST) with EffectBasePoints=-6, DieSides=1, so its real amount is -6+1=-5. Its classmask (family 20, dword1 bit24) matches every Twin Slice rank (e.g. 801901) by SpellFamilyFlags, and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST generically for any player spell, so Twin Slice's power cost drops by exactly 5.
